405: def advance(checkpoint, snapshot):
406:     with locked(checkpoint) as path:
407:         state = delivery_state(path)
408:         claim = state["claim"]
409:         validate_claim(claim)
410:         if state["phase"] == "readmission_pending" and state["recovery"].get("kind") == "amendment":
411:             return recovery_action(state, state["recovery"]["base_head"], path, "advance")
412:         recovery = observe_base(path, state, snapshot, "advance")
413:         if recovery:
414:             return recovery
415:         validate_snapshot(claim, snapshot, operation="advance", checkpoint=path)
416:         if state["phase"] == "readmission_pending":
417:             return recovery_action(state, state["recovery"]["base_head"], path, "advance")
418:         phase = state["phase"]
419:         if phase == "resolved":
420:             return response("advance", state, "stop", None)
421:         observation = fingerprint(snapshot)
422:         if observation not in state["observations"]:
423:             state["observations"].append(observation)
424:             state["observations"] = state["observations"][-8:]
425:         if snapshot["pr"].get("merged"):
426:             require("merge" in state["writes_offered"], "merge.owner", "no merge request offered by this checkpoint")
427:             state["merge_sha"] = snapshot["pr"]["merge_commit_sha"]
428:             if snapshot["issue"]["state"] == "closed":
429:                 require("close" in state["writes_offered"], "closure.owner", "no close request offered by this checkpoint")
430:                 state["issue_closed_at"] = snapshot["issue"]["closed_at"]
431:                 if phase not in {"reconciling", "resolved"}:
432:                     state["phase"] = "awaiting_reconcile"
433:             elif phase == "merge_pending":
434:                 state["phase"] = "close_pending"
435:                 state["delivery"] = {"action": "close", "status": "prepared"}
436:         elif phase == "admitted":
437:             require(snapshot["pr"].get("mergeable") is True, "pr.mergeable", snapshot["pr"].get("mergeable"))
438:             state["phase"] = "merge_pending"
439:             state["delivery"] = {"action": "merge", "status": "prepared"}
440:         save(path, state)
441:         prepared = state["phase"] in {"merge_pending", "close_pending"} and state["delivery"]["status"] == "prepared"
442:         if prepared:
443:             return response("advance", state, "dispatch", provider_next(claim, "dispatch", path))
444:         if state["phase"] in {"awaiting_reconcile", "reconciling"}:
445:             return response("advance", state, "reconcile", input_next("reconcile", ["binary"], path))
446:         return response("advance", state, "readback", provider_next(claim, "advance", path))

449: def dispatch(checkpoint, snapshot):
450:     """Consume one prepared intent for the supervisor's existing connector transport."""
451:     with locked(checkpoint) as path:
452:         state = delivery_state(path)
453:         claim = state["claim"]
454:         validate_claim(claim)
455:         require(state["phase"] != "readmission_pending", "dispatch.phase",
456:                 state["phase"], input_next("readmit", ["claim", "readback"], path))
457:         recovery = observe_base(path, state, snapshot, "dispatch")
458:         if recovery:
459:             return recovery
460:         validate_snapshot(claim, snapshot, operation="dispatch", checkpoint=path)
461:         require(state["phase"] in {"merge_pending", "close_pending"}, "dispatch.phase", state["phase"])
462:         delivery = state["delivery"]
463:         require(delivery["status"] == "prepared", "dispatch.status",
464:                 delivery["status"], provider_next(claim, "advance", path))
465:         if delivery["action"] == "merge":
466:             require(not snapshot["pr"].get("merged") and snapshot["pr"].get("mergeable") is True,
467:                     "dispatch.pr", "merge no longer eligible", provider_next(claim, "advance", path))
468:             request = {"action": "merge", "repository_full_name": REPOSITORY, "pr_number": claim["pr"],
469:                        "expected_head_sha": claim["head"], "merge_method": "merge"}
470:         else:
471:             require(snapshot["pr"].get("merged") and snapshot["issue"]["state"] == "open",
472:                     "dispatch.issue", "closure no longer eligible", provider_next(claim, "advance", path))
473:             request = {"action": "close", "repository_full_name": REPOSITORY, "issue_number": claim["issue"],
474:                        "state": "closed", "state_reason": "completed"}
475:         delivery["status"] = "offered"
476:         state["writes_offered"].append(delivery["action"])
477:         save(path, state)  # Must precede request emission; an interrupted offer remains unknown.
478:         return response("dispatch", state, request["action"], provider_next(claim, "advance", path), request=request)
